title: 9 Best Herbal Teas For Chickenpox
description: Urtica dioica teas, also known as stinging nettle tea, have been used to treat the chickenpox ailment due to their anti-inflammatory and antiviral properties. The herbal preparation helps to treat chickenpox by reducing the severity of symptoms, such as itching, fever, and rash, and by shortening the duration of the illness.
